verdict.rationale: Proa documents incremental adoption: you can proxy one route to Proa while the rest stays on Next.js or Rails, call Proa over FFI from Node, Go, Python, Ruby or Java, and adapt it to other HTTP servers. It also emits server-rendered HTML plus a small per-island JS module for interactive components. However, adoption is documented at the route level, not as dropping components into an existing server-rendered page. missing for 10: documented embedding of islands into an existing non-Proa HTML page, a guide for mounting components within legacy templates, hands-on or independent corroboration.
